trigger: In the first Qwen2.5-3B pair all four 64-token identity probes differed in generated IDs despite the same rendered prompt. Recheck all four frozen contexts for both models independently of measured service timing.
method: On the same held GPU after the crossover, render each frozen request with the checkpoint tokenizer, normalize structured historical tool arguments, exclude final tools just as serving does. Require exact prompt token hash and length equality. Use BF16 Transformers SDPA greedy cached generation up to 64 tokens. For the first Riley/vLLM divergence also evaluate a full forward pass on their common token prefix and store top-5 and both choices' logits. Natural answer correctness is a separate measure; this reference alone does not define a unique correct answer.
